analysisOverview: Analyzed 5176 historical order transactions across seeds spread-1, spread-2, spread-3, spread-4, spread-5. Identified 12 captive inelastic dealers suitable for aggressive quote ratchets (+€0.03..+€0.09) and 13 price-sensitive elastic accounts.

D07.strategicRationale: Steady conversion profile; standard baseline quoting.

D02.summary: Captive inelastic dealer with 21.5% win rate at above-average multipliers.
D02.strategicRationale: Strong empirical conversion indicates captive loyalty. Pre-seeding upward offset captures immediate early-week margin.
